_doc: Stream P-core (round 8, W9) — every NUMBER of the ten professions. Read by js/rules/professions.js (pure), js/sim/professions.js (server), tools/content-professions.mjs (content: materials, node kinds, recipes, placement -> data/provinces/professions*.json) and tools/sim-professions.mjs (gold per hour). Player-facing names live here and in the content file; nothing is hard-coded in the server.

professions.name: Mining
professions.blurb: Break ore out of boulders. Three strikes: time each one as the marker crosses the bright spot.

professions.name: Logging
professions.blurb: Fell marked trees for timber. Chop left, right, left, on the beat.

professions.name: Foraging
professions.blurb: Herbs, mushrooms and fibre. Pick the ripe ones before they close; leave the rest.

professions.name: Skinning
professions.blurb: Hides and meat from beasts you killed. Follow the cut line with a steady hand.

professions.name: Angling
professions.blurb: Fish any water. Wait for the float to dip, then keep the fish in the band.

professions.name: Smithing
professions.blurb: Smelt bars; forge metal weapons, shields, mail and plate. Hammer while the bar glows in the band; re-heat when it cools.

professions.name: Outfitting
professions.blurb: Cure leather, weave cloth; make cloth and leather armour, cloaks, belts, backpacks and bows. Stitch as each hole passes the needle.

professions.name: Alchemy
professions.blurb: Potions, tonics and casters' tools. Stop the pour at the mark, then the stir.

professions.name: Cooking
professions.blurb: Meals from fish, meat and what you forage, at any fire. Take the pot off at the mark.

professions.name: Tempering
professions.blurb: Improve gear you already own: raise its quality, promote its rarity, reweave a property, brand a weapon. Stop the gauge in the narrowing band. A miss costs the materials, never the item.

ease._doc: ease = (skill - the work's skill) x perSkill + the tool's own ease, 0..1; it widens every 'good' window by up to +50%

highScore._doc: round 11 (live #9): a gathering mini-game played to `from` (fine = score 0.65+, perfect = 0.9+) gives every main material x `mult` (rounded UP) and ONE find: finds[prof][tier - 1] (the last entry past the end) — always uncommon or better (the gems, golden resin, wild honeycomb and the beast fang carry rarity magic; the star opal rare). Angling has its own catch table and no find.

rarity._doc: crafted gear: round 11 (live #58) — never plain (`floor`: magic); the chance of RARE by mini-game quality, + perSkill.rare for each skill point past the recipe (to maxSurplus). Never above rare. extraAffix: a magic item may carry one more property (never a rare).

roles._doc: which town folk teach a profession (`trains`) and whose building is a station for one (`stations`). A station = standing within craft.stationM of them.

stationHint.tempering: the smith, the armourer or a jeweller

legendary._doc: X5 (round 9): temper_promote takes a RARE to LEGENDARY. `material` drops only from a world boss (chance.worldBoss per credited player) and from a won event of level >= topEventLevel (chance.topEvent). Cost: 1 material (KEPT on a miss) + `mat` of the item's tier material + `gem` gems of its tier + goldShare of its list price; Tempering `skill`. The item keeps everything and gains one legendary power that fits its slot.

temper._doc: tempering works on a gear item in your BAG. cost: `mat` = how many of the item's own tier material (bar for metal, leather, cloth, wood by what the item is), plus the listed extras; gold = share of the item's list price. Skill needed = the item tier's minSkill + `skill`. A miss spends the materials and gold fee; the item is untouched.

temper_quality.name: Temper
temper_quality.text: Raises the item's quality one step. Its damage or armour and every rolled property grow with it.

temper_promote.name: Promote
temper_promote.text: Raises the item's rarity one step: plain to uncommon, uncommon to rare (one new property each), and a rare to legendary with a Sovereign Core (it gains a legendary power).

temper_reweave.name: Reweave
temper_reweave.text: Replaces the one property you choose with a different one, rolled for the item's level.

temper_brand.name: Brand
temper_brand.text: Turns a share of a weapon's damage into an element of your choice. One brand per weapon.
